message.content: Yes, the view features a prominent navy-to-teal gradient hero section that includes a distinct "Question of the Day" badge. The math question is clearly displayed in the center, followed by four well-defined options labeled A, B, C, and D. The mathematical equations and variables are rendered correctly using standard text formatting for this type of interface. While a specific "Back to Dashboard" button is not visible in the main content area, the sidebar provides navigation back to other sections like "Quiz Center." The overall layout is exceptionally clean, utilizing a modern card-based design with ample white space that makes the interface feel professional and inviting. This design effectively highlights the daily challenge while maintaining an organized and user-friendly educational environment.
